title: Grid Snake
description: Steer the snake across the grid, collect golden apples, and avoid walls or your own tail.
overview: Guide your snake through a 20x20 arena, eating golden apples to extend your tail and build a high score. Each apple slightly increases your movement speed, turning tight corners into high-stakes maneuvers.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD (P to pause)
tips: Plan turns two tiles ahead once your snake grows past 15 segments.
Loop along the outer edges to keep the center open for safe escapes.
Touch directional buttons appear automatically on smaller screens.

title: Brick Breaker
description: Deflect the ball off your paddle to clear layered brick formations across progressive rounds.
overview: Bounce the steel ball off your paddle to shatter five layered rows of colored bricks. Clearing a full formation advances you to a faster round, while missing the ball costs one of your three lives.
controls: Mouse, Touch drag, or Left/Right arrows
tips: Hit the ball near the edges of your paddle to send it at sharper angles.
Aim to punch a tunnel up one side so the ball bounces above the top row.
Each new round speeds up the ball—stay centered between volleys.

title: 2048 Slide
description: Merge matching number tiles on a 4x4 board to reach the 2048 tile before running out of moves.
overview: Slide all tiles simultaneously in one of four directions on a 4x4 board. Whenever two tiles with the same number collide, they merge into their sum—keep combining values until you forge the 2048 tile.
tips: Keep your highest-value tile anchored in one corner of the board.
Build descending chains along the edge next to your anchor corner.
Use the Undo button if a forced move breaks your tile order.

title: Minesweeper
description: Uncover safe tiles using numerical adjacency clues and flag every hidden mine on the board.
overview: Deduce where hidden mines are buried across a 9x9 or 12x12 grid. Each revealed number tells you how many mines touch that square across all eight neighboring tiles—clear every safe square without detonating a mine.
controls: Left click reveal · Right click or Mode button to flag
tips: Your very first click is always safe and opens a clear starting pocket.
Switch between 9x9 (10 mines) and 12x12 (22 mines) in the top bar.
Toggle Mode: Flag for fast one-handed flagging on trackpads or touchscreens.

title: Asteroids Drift
description: Pilot your starship through deep space, split drifting asteroids, and survive escalating waves.
overview: Take control of a vector starfighter with zero-gravity momentum. Blast large asteroids into smaller, faster fragments while dodging debris across endless escalating waves with three lives.
controls: Left/Right turn · Up thrust · Spacebar fire
tips: Use short thrust bursts rather than holding Up continuously so you stay controllable.
Remember screen wrap—shots and asteroids cross from one edge to the opposite side.
Clear smaller fast fragments before splitting another large rock.

title: Memory Match
description: Flip cards two at a time to locate all matching geometric pairs in the fewest moves.
overview: A calm, focused visual recall challenge featuring 16 face-down geometric tiles (8 matching pairs). Flip two tiles per turn and clear the entire deck in as few moves as possible to beat your personal best.
tips: Scan rows systematically from top-left to bottom-right on your opening turns.
Pay close attention to unmatched flips—every mismatch teaches two positions.
Use New Shuffle anytime to beat your saved fewest-moves record.
